limitations.note: Instead of registering the light outputs to restore the counter’s edge detection, the rewrite removed that pipeline, turning red on during reset and changing the startup timing preserved by the reference fix.
The test required red to be on during reset, so it validated the rewrite’s assumption and would reject the reference fix, which keeps all lights off during reset.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The first simulation command was rejected before compilation because its cleanup used a prohibited command, so the test had to be resubmitted.
